map.📚 深度解析：PNH（流式 CD55/CD59）检测: 📚 Deep Dive: PNH Flow Cytometry for CD55/CD59
map.流式见 CD55/CD59 缺失群，按粒细胞克隆大小分型并判临床意义: When flow cytometry shows a population lacking CD55/CD59, type it by granulocyte clone size and judge the clinical significance.
map.结合 LDH、Hb、血栓史评估溶血负荷与治疗指征: Combine LDH, Hb and a history of thrombosis to assess the hemolytic burden and the indications for treatment.
map.区分大克隆(≥50%)/显著(10–50%)/微小(1–10%)，决定补体抑制治: Separate large clones (50% or more), significant clones (10–50%) and small clones (1–10%) to decide on complement inhibition.
map.克隆分型：I 型正常 + II 型(部分缺失) + III 型(完全缺失) =: Clone typing: type I normal plus type II (partial loss) plus type III (complete loss) = 100%, and the total PNH clone = type II + type III. Grading: 50% or more a large clone, 10–50% clinically significant, 1–10% small and below 1% subclinical. Type III cells are the most complement sensitive and the main source of hemolysis; LDH above 250 indicates active hemolysis and above 500 a marked rise.
map.例（II 型=10%、III 型=25%、LDH=450、Hb=85）：总克隆=: Example (type II = 10%, type III = 25%, LDH = 450, Hb = 85): total clone = 10 + 25 = 35%, a clinically significant PNH clone, and type I = 100 − 35 = 65%; type III at 25%, which is at least 20%, means a high hemolysis risk, and LDH 450 is a mild to moderate rise with Hb 85 indicating moderate anemia. Taken together, complement inhibitor treatment should be assessed.
map.为什么看粒细胞克隆而不是红细胞？: Why look at the granulocyte clone rather than red cells?
map.粒细胞寿命短、不受输血稀释，FLAER/粒细胞克隆最可靠；红细胞 CD59/CD: Granulocytes are short lived and not diluted by transfusion, so the FLAER or granulocyte clone is the most reliable; red cell CD55/CD59 is diluted by transfused normal red cells and often underestimates the true PNH clone, so the granulocyte line is taken as standard.
map.微小克隆(<10%)也要治吗？: Does a small clone (below 10%) need treatment?
map.通常不需 PNH 靶向治疗，重点排查是否合并再生障碍性贫血（AA/PNH 综合征: Usually no PNH-targeted therapy is needed; the focus is on checking for coexisting aplastic anemia (AA/PNH syndrome) and monitoring clone evolution regularly, intervening if cytopenias appear or the clone grows.
